title: CactusPVP
description: CactusPVP is a low-end optimized Fabric PvP modpack for Minecraft 1.21.4–1.21.11, built for smooth performance and clean combat visibility.
body:
# 🌵 CactusPVP Modpack

**CactusPVP Modpack** is a lightweight, performance-focused PvP modpack built specifically for competitive players on low-end PCs.

Designed for modern Minecraft versions (**1.21.4 – 1.21.11**) using Fabric, this pack removes unnecessary bloat and focuses on what actually matters: **smooth gameplay, high FPS, and clear combat visibility**.

With powerful optimization mods like **Sodium and its ecosystem**, CactusPVP delivers a major performance boost without sacrificing gameplay quality—perfect for intense PvP situations.

---

## ⚔️ Features

- 🚀 **High FPS Optimization**
  - Powered by Sodium and performance-focused mods  
  - Built for low-end PCs  

- 👁️ **Improved Combat Visibility**
  - Smaller shields and totems  
  - Reduced hand item size  
  - Low fire overlay  

- 🎯 **PvP Enhancements**
  - Totem counter  
  - Cleaner totem pop visuals  
  - Armor durability display  

- 🧠 **Clarity & Awareness**
  - Fullbright for better visibility  
  - Custom textures to differentiate **Breach vs Density maces**  

---

## 🧩 Technical Details

- **Minecraft Versions:** 1.21.4 – 1.21.11  
- **Mod Loader:** Fabric  
- **Focus:** PvP Optimization & Visual Clarity  
- **Performance:** Optimized for low-end systems  

---

## 🏆 Why CactusPVP?

CactusPVP is built for players who want a **competitive edge without unnecessary distractions**.

Every feature is designed to:
- Reduce visual clutter  
- Improve reaction time  
- Keep gameplay smooth and responsive  

Whether you're playing duels, FFA, or competitive PvP servers, this modpack gives you a **cleaner and more consistent experience**.

---

## ⚡ Summary

**More FPS. Less clutter. Better fights.**
